description: Perennial much-branched climber to 8 m long; subglabrous or hairy; stem of leafy shoots 2(–3) mm diam.; rarely monoecious. Probract usually present. Tendrils spiraling either throughout their length or only in the upper part. Leaves: blade simple, ovate, 6–10 by 4–9 cm, upper surface appressed-hairy, scabrous by cystoliths, lower surface hairy or subglabrous, base deeply cordate, margin coarsely or finely dentate, apex acute-acuminate; petiole 3–6 cm long, finely hairy or subglabrous. Male inflorescences a peduncled bracteate raceme (sometimes with a previously developed solitary flower at base), 5–10 cm, sparsely minutely pubescent; peduncle 2–5 cm long, at or close to the base with a rhombiform or sub-elliptic (5–)10 mm long irregularly incised probract; flowers few or several, bracts close together, or in older inflorescences the scars of the fallen flowers and bracts more spaced, forming an up to 3 cm long spike, with few bracteate flowers and buds at apex; bracts obovate or obtriangular, 10–15 mm long, the margin in the apical half (irregularly) dentate or incised to ca ¼ deep. Male flowers: pedicel ca 10 mm long; receptacle-tube obliquely cup-shaped, tapering, 3–4 mm diam., throat short-hairy; sepals long-triangular, or oblong, 8–12 by 3–5 mm, acute, 3(–5) veined, sometimes reflexed; petals in bud erect and much shorter than sepals, expanded petals obovate-elliptic, 15–20 by ca 15 mm, apex rounded and faintly dentate; filaments short, 3–5 mm long, ± curved, ± dilated towards the base, anthers 3–5 mm long, slightly curved, median(?) petal with conspicuous curved scale, ca 4 mm, concealing the disc in the receptacle-tube; disc inserted slightly laterally, large, ellipsoid, ca 4 mm long. Female flowers solitary; pedicel 10–40 mm long, with probract at or near base; perianth as in male flowers; ovary ovoid-ellipsoid, densely woolly grey-hairy, ca 10 mm long; style-column ca 2 mm long, arms 4–5 mm long; stigmas 2-lobed, lobes broadly reniform, each ca 3 mm diam., staminodes ca 1.5 mm long, erect. Fruit solitary; oblong-cylindrical, (2–)3–6 by 2–2.5 cm, broadly rounded at both ends, sparsely or densely bristly hairy, outer surface fenestrately pitted in ca 15 rows; fruiting pedicel 1.5–4 cm long. Seeds ovoid, 5–6 mm long, somewhat flattened, rugose, margin shallowly 2-grooved.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Herbaceous few-branched climber 1.5–4 m long, from a tuberous root; young parts finely hairy, largely glabrescent; stem 2(–4) mm diam. Probract absent, except in connection with inflorescences, in male small, up to 5 mm long, at or towards base of inflorescences, in female not obvious. Tendrils not spiraling basally. Leaves: blade simple, unlobed or lobed, or 3- or 5-foliolate, (broadly) ovate in outline, 7–20(–25) by 4–15(–20) cm, upper surface with sparse (minute) coarse hairs, later on leaving sparse cystoliths, lower surface glabrous, except for few hairs on veins, base deeply cordate, margin finely (coarsely) dentate, apex acute acuminate; petiole 2–7 cm long, petiolules to 1 cm long. Male inflorescences usually a peduncled raceme (rarely few-branched), 2–12 cm long, including 1.5–5 cm long peduncle, early glabrescent, at base usually with a scar of fallen small probract, and a solitary pedicel 20–30 mm long of previously developed flower; flowers in raceme (few to) numerous; lower portion of pedicels persistent; bracts absent. Male flowers: bud with open calyx, imitating small flowers; pedicels 5–15 mm long; receptacle-tube shallowly cup-shaped, 2–3 by 5–7 mm, slightly oblique at base because of eccentric disc, inside minutely gland-hairy, throat minutely gland-hairy; sepals narrowly elliptic, 4–6 by 2–2.5 mm, 3- or 5-veined, out-curved, apex greenish (often black on drying), (sub)acute; petals ovate-oblong, 10–15 by 8–10 mm, obtuse, 5(–7)-veined, at apex of midvein with a minute gland; filaments short, 3–4 mm long, anthers ca 2.5 mm long; median? petal at base with a large curved scale, ca 2.5 mm long, concealing the disc; disc globose ellipsoid, ca 2.5 mm diam. Female flowers solitary or 2 or 3 in up to 2 cm long raceme; pedicel (10–)20 mm long; sepals and petals similar to those of male flowers, but narrower; ovary subfusiform, ca 15 by 3 mm, at apex long-tapering, brownish short-woolly; style ca 2.5 mm long, stigma-arms 0.5(–1) mm long; stigmas reniform, ca 1.5 mm diam.; staminodes in two pairs and 1 solitary, ca 0.5 mm long, glandular-papillose; basal petal scale not obvious. Fruit (after Hooker and Thomson 1703, Khasia (K), and A.M. Lu & Zhi Y. Zhang, Flora Sinica) narrowly or broadly oblong, 3.5–6 by 2–3 cm, rounded at base, tapering at apex, minutely sparsely hairy, white, green striped; fruiting pedicel slender, ca 3 cm long. Seeds broadly ovoid, 6–7 by 5 mm, base obtuse-rounded, smooth.

description: Climber a few meters long, putatively with a tuberous rootstock; leafy shoot 2–3 mm thick, soft grey-hairy, hairs 1–2 mm long, glandular or not. Probract not obvious. Tendrils not spiraling in the basal third. Leaves: blade simple, ovate or ovate-oblong, 9–17 by 5–10 cm, upper surface sparsely hairy, cystoliths not obvious, lower surface more densely hairy, especially on veins, base deeply cordate, margin finely dentate, apex acute-acuminate; petiole 2.5–6 cm long, soft-hairy. Male inflorescences: flowers solitary or in an up to 12-flowered peduncled raceme to 10 cm long; bracts absent (possibly minute and early caducous); peduncle to 5 cm long, hairy. Male flowers: pedicel 15–25 mm long, hairy; receptacle-tube broadly campanulate, ca 3 by 4–5 mm, outside with long, stiff, whitish hairs, throat finely papillose-hairy; sepals oblong, ca 5 mm, at base 1.5(–2) mm wide, acute, hairy; petals ovate-oblong, 15–20 by 7–10 mm, obtuse, 5–7-veined, inside and margin papillose; filaments 3.5–4 mm long, papillose, anthers 3–3.5 mm long; petal basal scales 1 large, ca 3 mm long, with 2 or 3 smaller ones forming a finely hairy diaphragm-like ring, ca 0.5 mm high; disc 1–1.5 mm across. Female flowers solitary; pedicel (5–)10 mm long; perianth smaller than in male flowers, petals narrower; ovary short-fusiform, ca 4 by 2.5–3 mm, subglabrous or sparsely hairy; sepals ca 4 mm long; petals ca 13 mm long; style-column ca 2.5 mm long, style-arms (1.5–)2 mm long; stigmas ca 1 mm diam.; staminodes in two pairs and 1 solitary, erect, ca 0.5 mm long, papillose; petal basal scale small. Fruit not known.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climber to 10 m long, possibly with tuberous root; stem of leafy shoots (2–)3(–4) mm thick, rather densely soft-patently hairy, hairs pale brown, (1–)2–3 mm long. Probract usually absent, occasionally present (when male inflorescence with solitary flower at base of peduncle present), ± rhomboid-elliptic, ca 15 mm long, dentate or incised in apical half. Tendrils not spiraling in lower third, hairy. Leaves: blade simple, ovate (or ovate-oblong), 7–17 by 4.5–12 cm, upper surface ± sparsely mixed-hairy, the shorter hairs finally leaving small cystoliths, lower surface more densely hairy especially on veins, base deeply cordate, margin (densely) finely dentate, apex acute-acuminate; petiole 4–12 cm, soft-hairy. Male inflorescences a peduncled raceme, 6–15 cm long, with up to 20 bracteate flowers crowded in a head 2.5–4 cm diam. at apex; peduncle 5–10 cm long, soft-hairy, hairs (1–)2–3 mm long; bracts ± rhomboid-obovate or wedge-shaped, 1.5(–2) by 1.5 cm, the apical part rounded, shallowly or deeply (¼ to ½) incised, the lobes acute to long-acuminate, base narrow, subglabrous to (sparsely) long-hairy, hairs 0.5–2 mm long; bracts persistent after flowering. Male flowers sparsely hairy, frequently up to 3 open flowers in one raceme; pedicel short, 2(–3) mm long, articulate towards base; receptacle-tube broadly cup-shaped, ca 3 by 5 mm, finely papillose in the throat; sepals (oblong-)linear, 8–12 by 1–1.5 mm, 3(–5)-veined, sparsely hairy; petals oblong, obtuse, 15–20 by 7–10 mm, 7-veined, inside finely papillose; basal petal scales one or two large, 2–2.5 mm long, up to 3 smaller ones present or absent; filaments 3–4 mm long (one shorter than the others), glandular-hairy, anthers 3–4 mm long; disc ca 2.5 mm diam. Female flowers solitary or 2; pedicel ca 15 mm long; perianth slightly smaller than in male; ovary broadly ellipoid, densely pale brown-hairy, 8–10 by ca 6 mm. Fruit solitary, subglobose, ca 3 by 2.5 cm, irregularly striate-verrucose, (sparsely) hairy; fruiting pedicel ca 6 cm. Seeds pear-shaped (or ovoid), somewhat narrowed at base, rather flattened, ca 5 by 3.5 by 1.5 mm, finely verrucose, margin ± square.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climber 2–3 m long (stouter in all parts in var. anguina); annual or subperennial; monoecious; with (sparse) minute hairs, partly glabrescent; plant green, not reddish tinged; cystoliths not obvious; stem 1.5–2(–5) mm diam. Probract absent. Tendrils 2- or 3-branched. Leaves: blade unlobed, or shallowly or deeply 3–5(–7)-lobed, suborbicular or broadly ovate in outline, 5–10(–17) by 6–8(–17) cm, hairy or subscabrous below, glands absent, base cordate with broad sinus, margin entire or sparsely finely dentate, apex acute; petiole 2–10 cm long. Male inflorescences 9–14(–20) cm long, hairy, (glabrescent); peduncle 7–15 cm long, 1–2 mm thick; rachis with up to 20 flowers; bracts persistant or caducous, 1–2 mm long, without glands. Male flowers: pedicel 3–15 mm long; receptacle-tube 15–19 mm long, at throat ca 3 mm wide; sepals linear, ca 2 mm long, margin entire; petals ovate-oblong, narrowly elliptic, 5–6(–10) mm long, threads ca 10 mm long (open corolla ca 30 mm diam.); synandrium 2(–3) mm long, filaments less than 1 mm long. Female flowers: pedicel 5–15(–30) mm long; ovary (narrowly) ellipsoid, 10(–30) mm long, finely hairy. Fruits green, turning orange-red, paler speckled or longitudinally banded, ovoid or narrowly ellipsoid, narrowed towards apex, 2.5–5 by 1.5–4 cm (up to ca 100 cm long in var. anguina, see note); exocarp thinly leathery, smooth; pulp orange; fruiting pedicel 1–2(–3) cm long. Seeds grey or pale or dark brown, compressed, elliptic(-oblong), 6–18 by 4–9 by 2.5–3.5 mm, margin broad but faint, edge undulate.</br>Field-note. In contrast to most Trichosanthes species, the flowers of T. cucumerina are open at day time, the corollas falling off in the afternoon.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Stoutish climber; wholly green; cystoliths obvious; stem 4–5 mm diam., glabrous, slightly waxy. Probract subovate, ca 13 by 8 mm, unlobed, ± scabrous, with glands. Tendrils 4- or 5 branched. Leaves: blade 3-lobed to ca ⅓ deep, ovate-orbicular in outline, ca 24 by 20 cm, glabrous above, scabrous with very short stiff hairs below, glands few to several, scattered, ca 0.5 mm diam.; base cordate, mid-lobe obovate, ca 8.5 by 8 cm; margin with minute yellowish hard teeth; apex acute-acuminate; petiole 8–9 cm long. Male and female flowers not seen. Fruits subglobose, ca 8 cm diam.; pericarp thin when overripe; exocarp ca 0.5 mm thick, smooth; pulp watery, greenish-blackish; fruiting pedicel ca 2 by 0.5 cm. Seeds bright light brown, narrowly ellipsoid, subcylindrical (hardly compressed), 12–16 by 5 by 4 mm, apex and base (narrowly) rounded, faces smooth, margin obscure, edge rounded, entire.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Medium-sized climber; green, but flowers reddish (inflorescences not seen from Thailand); cystoliths obvious; stem 1–2(–3) mm diam., glabrous. Probract broadly ovate, 2–4 by 3–4 mm, subentire, glabrescent, with few glands. Tendrils 2- or 3-branched. Leaves: blade deeply 3–5-lobed, ovate-orbicular in outline, 8–15 by 7–12 cm, glabrous and scabrous, glands 2–5, large, close to the vein-axils towards the blade base, 1–1.5 mm diam.; base cordate, mid lobe narrowly ellipic, narrowed at base, up to 12 by 4 cm; margin coarsely serrate-dentate; apex acute-acuminate, mucronate; petiole 3–5 cm long. Male inflorescences (not known from Thailand, description from Esquirol 726, S China) 7–10 cm long, glabrescent or finely hairy; peduncle ca 4 cm long, 2–3 mm thick; rachis short, with ca 10 flowers; bracts persistent, broadly obovate, 20–25 by 20 mm, glands few, ca 1 mm diam., margin shallowly incised, 2–3 mm deep. Male flowers finely hairy; pedicel short, ca 2 mm long; receptacle-tube ca 15 mm long, at throat ca 8 mm wide; sepals long-triangular, ca 9 by 3 mm, margin entire; petals ca 10 by 10 mm, threads not studied; synandrium not studied. Fruits ellipsoid, 5–7.5 by 4.5–5.5 cm; pericarp 5–10 mm thick; exocarp coarsely wrinkled on drying; pulp greenish-blackish; fruiting pedicel 2–2.5 by ca 0.4 cm. Seeds pale brown, little compressed, ovoid-ellipsoid, 10–12 by 5–7 by 3–5 mm, blunt or rounded at both ends, smooth, margin absent, edge rounded, entire.</br>Field-note.— Fresh fruit (possibly not fully mature) hard, glossy green with yellowish streaks.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climber to 20 m long; wholly green; cystoliths inconspicuous; stem 2–3 mm diam., glabrous. Probract sublinear, 7–10 by 1.5–2 mm, glabrescent, with glands. Tendrils 2- or 3 branched. Leaves: blade shallowly or deeply 3–5-lobed, ovate-orbicular in outline, 11–20 by 9–20 cm, (thinly) membranaceous, glabrous at both surfaces, glands numerous, small, including few to several below the lowermost veins close to the insertion of the petiole; base cordate with wide sinus, lobes triangular to oblong, mid-lobe to 16 cm long; margin entire or coarsely sinuate; apex acute-acuminate; petiole 5–8 cm long. Male inflorescences 15–20 cm long, glabrous, co-axillary with a ca 10 cm long pedicelled solitary male flower; peduncle ca 15 cm long, 1–2 mm thick; rachis with 3–5 flowers; bracts persistent, narrowly elliptic, acute at both ends, 15–20 by 10 mm, with numerous small glands, margin entire. Male flowers (submature) early glabrescent, hairs minute, grey; pedicel slender, 20(–30) mm long; receptacle-tube ca 25 mm long, at throat 5–6 mm wide; sepals sparsely hairy, linear, 10–15 mm long, ca 1.5 mm wide at base, with distinct mid-vein, margin entire; petals wedge-shaped, ca 10 mm long; synandrium ca 6 mm long, filaments ca 5 mm long, glabrous. Female flowers not seen. Fruits orange to red, subglobose, ca 7 cm diam.; pericarp 10–15 mm thick; exocarp coarsely wrinkled on drying; pulp blackish; fruiting pedicel straight, ca 2 by 0.4–0.5 cm. Seeds dark reddish brown, compressed, irregularly elliptic (to quadrangular), 10–12 by 5–7 by ca 1 mm, apex and base irregularly retuse, truncate or blunt, faces smooth, margin broad but obscure, edge square, entire or faintly undulate.

description: Climber ca 25 m long; glabrous (sparse minute hairs on growing apices); purple-red in growing shoots; cystoliths obvious; stem 3–5 mm diam. Probract ovate-elliptic, 3–8 by 3–4 mm, unlobed, green, with glands. Tendrils 2–5-branched. Leaves: blade shallowly or deeply 3– 5-lobed, orbicular in outline, 12–24 by 11–22 cm, glabrous, glands large, several or numerous, scattered, 0.5–1.5 mm diam.; base (deeply) cordate, lobes ovate or oblong, mid-lobe to 12 cm long; margin (sparsely) shallowly serrate-dentate; apex acute-acuminate; petiole 5–9 cm long. Male inflorescences, male and female flowers not known; possibly resembling those of T. rubriflos subsp. fissisepala. Fruits red, ovoid, 6–8 by 4.5–6 cm, towards apex narrowed into a short beak ca 0.3 cm long; pericarp 10(–15) mm thick; exocarp leathery, coarsely wrinkled on drying; pulp greenish black; fruiting pedicel 3–6.5 by 0.4(–0.5) cm. Seeds blackish brown, compressed, irregularly elliptic in outline, 13–16 by 7–10 by ca 2.5 mm, apex subtruncate, base cuneate, margin distinct or faint, edge ± rounded, entire.

description: Climber to 10 m long; dark brown, yellowish or reddish brown-hairy, hairs 1–2 mm long; plant not reddish tinged; cystoliths not obvious; stem 3–4 mm diam., late glabrescent. Probract absent. Tendrils 2–7-branched, part below point of branching short, 0.5–1 cm long. Leaves: blade unlobed, ovate in outline, 12–28 by 9–20 cm, densely (grey-)rusty short villose on both surfaces, glands not obvious; base cordate; margin entire; apex acute-acuminate, 5–10 mm mucronate; petiole 5–11 cm long. Male inflorescences 10–20 cm long, wholly densely hairy, with co-axillary a densely hairy old pedicel 5–13 cm long; peduncle 8–17 cm long, 2–3 mm thick; rachis with 3–6 flowers; bracts inserted on the pedicel below the middle, (late) caducous, elliptic or rhomboid, 10–20 by 3–8 mm, glands not obvious, margin entire or shallowly few lobed. Male flowers hairy; pedicel 20–25 mm long; receptacle-tube 10–20 mm long, at throat ca 9 mm wide; sepals linear, 7–9 mm long, 1–2 mm wide at base, margin entire; petals wedge shaped, ca 25 mm long, threads ca 5 mm long; synandrium 5–7 mm long, filaments 3–5 mm long, glabrous, inserted towards the base of the tube. Female flowers: pedicel ca 20 mm long; ovary hairy, ellipsoid, 20–30 mm long; receptacle-tube ca 15 mm long; sepals hairy, long triangular, ca 15 mm long, margin entire. Fruits orange(-green), longitudinally paler striped, ellipsoid, 7–10 by 6–7 cm; exocarp ca 0.5 mm thick, leathery or woody, not wrinkled on drying, with sparse brown hairs, glabrescent; pulp creamy, sweet; fruiting pedicel 2.5–6 by 0.6–0.8 cm. Seeds dark brown, compressed, elliptic, 14–16 by 9–11 mm, base rounded, apex truncate or notched, margin distinct, ca 3 mm wide, edge shallowly undulate.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climber 5–8 m long; minutely hairy, early glabrescent; plant green, corolla white; cystoliths not obvious; stem 1–2 mm diam. Probract absent or (narrowly) elliptic, subentire, ca 3 mm long, with glands. Tendrils unbranched. Leaves: blade 3-lobed to (½–)⅔ deep (of juvenile shoots unlobed), orbicular in outline, 8–14 by 10–14 cm, membranous, glabrous, drying pale green below, glands several, scattered, ca 1 mm diam.; base broadly cuneate, truncate or rounded, mid-lobe oblong, to 8 by 4 cm; margin entire; apex (long) acute-acuminate; petiole 1.5–3 cm long. Male inflorescences ca 15 cm long, minutely hairy, glabrescent; peduncle 5–9 cm long, ca 2.5 mm thick; rachis with 10–12 flowers; bracts late caducous, (narrowly) elliptic, acute, 30–40 by 15–20 mm, with glands, margin serrate, teeth, narrow, 2–3 mm long. Male flowers: pedicel caducous, ca 15 mm long; receptacle-tube 30–35 mm long, ca 5 mm wide at throat; sepals linear, 12–15 by 1.5 mm, long-acute, sparsely minutely hairy, margin entire, without glands; petals and androecium not seen. Female flowers solitary or in a short 1–3-flowered raceme ca 1 cm long, the flower axillary to a conspicuous bract resembling male bracts; ovary glabrous; sepals finely hairy, oblong to linear, entire. Fruits orange-red, sparsely pale yellow-blotched, narrowly ovoid, ca 12 by 4.5 cm, apex acute; exocarp smooth; pulp green-black; fruiting pedicel ca 1.5 by 0.3 cm. Seeds pale brown, narrowly ellipsoid, somewhat compressed, ca 16 by 9 by 6 mm, without margin.

description: Climber 7–15 m long; wholly setose, hairs stiff, grey or brown, 2–4 mm long; plant green (not reddish tinged), petals white; cystoliths not obvious; stem 3–4 mm diam. Probract absent. Tendrils 2–5-branched, portion below point of branching ca 1.5 cm long. Leaves: blade deeply 5-lobed to ca ⅔ deep, suborbicular in outline, 16–31 by 13–28 cm, hairy on both surfaces, glands several to many, less than 0.5 mm diam.; base cordate with broad sinus, mid-lobe oblong, to 17 cm long; margin entire; apex acute-acuminate, to 15 mm long mucronate; petiole 8–13 cm long. Male inflorescences: flowers either solitary, a raceme or inflorescences composed of several racemes arranged in loose lateral shoots, 50–100 cm long, on the older wood (where stem 10–12 mm thick), each raceme with a reduced leaf or linear bract 10–20 mm long and with or without a reduced tendril at the node; raceme lax, (6–)10–20 cm long, hairy, mostly co axillary with a densely hairy old pedicel 5–13 cm long (without flower); peduncle (3–)12–14 cm long, ca 2 mm thick; rachis with 3–8 flowers; bracts mostly inserted on the pedicel below the middle, persistent, ± rhomboid, 15–25 by 5–15 mm, apex acuminate, mucronate, with minute glands, margin entire. Male flowers wholly ± densely brown-hairy, hairs 2–4 mm long; pedicel 5–40 mm long; receptacle-tube ca 20 mm long, at throat ca 10 mm diam., base faintly swollen, forming a cup-shaped ‘pseudo-ovary’; sepals narrowly triangular or linear, 15–20 mm long, 2–3 mm wide at base, margin entire; petals finely hairy, wedge-shaped, 15–20 mm long, threads ca 10 mm long; synandrium ca 10 mm long, with anthers closely appressed but free, filaments ca 3 mm long, hairy at the base, inserted towards the base in the tube, at apex of ‘pseudo ovary’. Female flowers: pedicel 50–80 mm long; ovary narrowly ellipsoid, ca 35 by 10 mm, densely hairy; corolla as in male. Fruits (slightly immature) green, white striped, narrowly ellipsoid, ca 15 by 6–8 cm; pericarp fleshy; exocarp thin, leathery, sparsely hairy, glabrescent; pulp whitish; fruiting pedicel ca 11 by 0.3 cm. Seeds (immature) compressed, elliptc, ca 1 cm long, margin entire.

description: Climber 2–7 m long; subperennial; variously short-hairy; plant green on drying; cystoliths not obvious; stem 2–3 mm diam. Probract absent. Tendrils 2- or 3-branched. Leaves: blade unlobed or (deeply) 3–5-lobed, (broadly) ovate or suborbicular in outline, 10–19(–25) by 9–16(–19) cm, hairy below, at least along the (finer) veins, glands absent or few, scattered, ca 0.5 mm diam.; base cordate, with broad or narrow sinus; margin entire or sparsely finely or coarsely dentate or undulate; apex acute-acuminate, short mucronate; petiole 3–7 cm long. Male inflorescences 15–20(–25) cm long, densely or sparsely short-hairy, sometimes co axillary with a long-pedicelled male flower; peduncle 8–17 cm long, 1–2 mm thick; rachis with 5–10 flowers; bracts caducous or persistent, (narrowly) obovate or oblong, 6–20 by 1–5 mm, without glands, margin few-lobed or dentate. Male flowers: pedicel (3–)5–25 mm long (in solitary flower much longer); receptacle-tube 15–45 mm long, at apex 3–5 mm diam.; sepals narrowly triangular, 3–15 mm long, 1–2 mm wide at base, margin entire; petals ovate-oblong or oblong-lanceolate, ca 10 by 4 mm, subglabrous, threads 7–17 mm long; synandrium 3–4 mm long, filaments 1–2 mm long, glabrous. Female flowers resembling male; pedicel ca 10 mm long; ovary ellipsoid-oblong, ca 8 by 2–3 mm, hairy or subglabrous; receptacle-tube to 55 mm long; sepals to 20 mm long. Fruits orange-red, pale flamed, ellipsoid(-oblong), 4–6 by 3–4 cm, apex acute, 3–5 mm beaked; exocarp leathery, smooth; pulp whitish or orange-red; fruiting pedicel 1–2 by 0.2 cm. Seeds (dark) brown, swollen, with broad belt, 6–8 by 5–9 by 3–5 mm.

description: Climber 5–20 m long; rarely monoecious; (sub)glabrous, hairs minute; plant green, blackish on drying, petals white; cystoliths usually not obvious; stem 3–5 mm diam. Probract obovate-oblong, 8–12(–15) mm long, with glands. Tendrils (2–)3–5-branched. Leaves: blade 3–5-angular or lobed to ca ¼ deep, suborbicular in outline, 8–21 by 7–16 cm, ± scabrous above, glands several or numerous, close to the vein-axils, especially several in the axils of the main veins at very base of the blade, 0.5–1 mm diam.; base deeply cordate, lobes triangular; margin entire; apex acute-acuminate; petiole 2.5–8(–10) cm long. Male inflorescences 10–25(–30) cm long, glabrescent; peduncle 7–14 cm long, 2–3 mm thick; rachis with 5–20 flowers, bracts late-caducous, (ob)ovate-elliptic or ± rhomboid, 15–25 mm long, with glands near mid vein, margin (sub)entire. Male flowers: pedicel (sub)caducous, 2–5(–10) mm long; receptacle-tube 30–50 mm long, at apex ca 7 mm wide; sepals long-triangular, 10–15 mm long, 2–3 mm wide at base, margin with few slender side-lobes in basal part; petals very finely hairy, obovate or broadly cuneate, ca 20 mm long, threads 10–15 mm long; synandrium 6–8 mm long, filaments 1–3 mm long, glabrous. Female flowers: pedicel 5–8(–20) mm long; ovary (ovoid-)ellipsiod, ca 8 by 4 mm, glabrous; receptacle-tube (25–)40–60 mm long; sepals smaller and narrower than in male, ca 10 by 1 mm, entire. Fruits bright red, (depressed) globose, 5–6(–7) cm diam., apex not beaked; pericarp 10–15 mm thick; exocarp leathery, smooth, coarsely wrinkled on drying or not; pulp green-black; fruiting pedicel 1–3 by 0.4–0.5 cm, usually curved. Seeds pale brown, compressed, elliptic-oblong, 8–10 by 4–5 by 1(–2) mm, pointed at one end, margin absent, edge entire, square in section.

description: Climber, several meters long; monoecious?; subglabrous, hairs shaggy, 0.5 mm long, largely early glabrescent; plant green, blackish on drying, petals white; cystoliths not obvious; stem 2(–3) mm diam. Probract absent. Tendrils unbranched. Leaves: blade unlobed or deeply 3–5-lobed to ¾ deep, the lower lobes straight and downwards directed, ovate or suborbicular in outline, 7–15 by 5–12 cm, chartaceous, (sub)glabrous, drying green below, glands absent; base deeply cordate with narrow or broad sinus, or (sub)hastate, mid-lobe to 13 by 2.5 cm; margin (entire or) finely serrate-dentate; apex acute-acuminate; petiole 1.5–4.5 cm long. Male inflorescences 12–14 cm long, (densely) minutely brown-hairy, sometimes co-axillary with a solitary flower; peduncle 3–4 cm long, 1.5–2 mm thick; rachis with 15–20 flowers; bracts late caducous, chartaceous, subovate, 9–10 by 4–5 mm, with glands, margin serrate-lobed. Male flowers greyish hairy, glabrescent; pedicel caducous, ca 5 mm long (10–20 mm long in solitary flower); perianth immature, presumably as in female flowers; synandrium ca 6 mm long, filaments ca 3 mm long, subglabrous. Female flowers: pedicel ca 15 mm long; ovary narrowly ellipsoid, much narrowed towards apex, ca 10 by 2.5 mm, glabrous; receptacle-tube 15–25 mm long, at apex ca 4 mm wide; sepals long-triangular or linear, ca 10 mm long, 1–1.5 mm wide, with glands, margin entire; petals ca 12 mm long, threads ca 6 mm long. Fruits green with whitish longitudinal streaks, ovoid, (narrowly) ellipsoid, 7.5–9 by 3.5–4 cm, narrowed at both ends, especially at apex; exocarp leathery, smooth; pulp not known; fruiting pedicel 1.5–2.5 by 0.3 cm. Seeds (from detached material) pale brown, slightly compressed, ovoid-ellipsoid, 11–13 by 7–8 by 5 mm, apex narrowly, the base broadly obtuse, smooth, margin absent, edge entire.</br>Field-notes.— Fruit light green with whitish-greyish vertical streaks. Leaves polymorphic, entire or lobed.

description: Climber 5–20 m long; occasionally monoecious; minutely hairy, early glabrescent; plant green, brown on drying, petals white; cystoliths obvious; stem 2–4 mm diam. Probract (broadly) elliptic or obovate, 2–11 by 2–5 mm, unlobed, with glands. Tendrils 2- or 3-branched. Leaves: blade shallowly (or deeply) 3–5-lobed, to ⅓(–¾) deep, broadly ovate or orbicular in outline, (4–)7–15 by (3–)5–14 cm, (sub)scabrous above, glabrous below, glands few to several, scattered, 0.5–1 mm diam.; base cordate, mid-lobe triangular or ellipsoid(-oblong), to 12 cm long; margin (sub)entire or ± coarsely dentate; apex acute(-acuminate), apex of side-lobes frequently somewhat down-curved; petiole 3–7.5 cm long. Male inflorescences 7–16 cm long, hairy (partly glabrescent); peduncle (2–)5–11 cm long, ca 0.2 cm thick; rachis with 3–20 flowers; bracts persistent or late-caducous, (broadly) obovate-elliptic or rhomboid, 15–30(–40) by 14–20 mm, with conspicuous glands, margin at apical portion irregularly lobed or incised, 2–7 mm deep. Male flowers short-hairy; pedicel caducous, 3–5 mm long; receptacle-tube 30(–50) mm long, at apex 4–7 mm wide; sepals (narrowly) ovate-triangular or oblong, 10–16 mm long, 3–5 mm wide at base, margin entire or ± lobed at base, or serrate, without or with glands; petals obovate-rhomboid, ca 15 mm long, threads ca 20 mm long; synandrium 6–10 mm long, filaments ca 3 mm long, (sub)glabrous. Female flowers (not known from Thailand): pedicel 5–10 mm long; ovary ovoid, ca 10 mm long, glabrous (glabrescent); perianth as in male. Fruits bright red, (ellipsoid-)ovoid, 6–7 by ca 4.5 cm; exocarp leathery, smooth, coarsely wrinkled on drying; pulp green-black; fruiting pedicel 1–2 by 0.3–0.4 cm. Seeds dark brown, compressed, obovate elliptic or oblong, 9–10 by 5–6 by 1.5–2–3) mm, margin absent, edge square or rounded, entire.

description: Climber, 4–10 m long; glabrous or very minutely hairy, glabrescent; plant green, not reddish tinged, petals white; cystoliths not obvious; stem 2–4 mm diam. Probract absent. Tendrils unbranched (Annam) or 2- or 3-branched in Thailand. Leaves: blade unlobed or rarely (deeply) 3-lobed, ovate(-oblong), 8–16 by 7–14 cm, glabrous, glands absent; base broadly rounded or shallowly cordate (sometimes slightly peltate); margin subentire or sparsely sharply dentate, with apical teeth 1–1.5 mm long; apex acute-acuminate, veins prominent below; petiole 3–6 cm long. Male inflorescences (4–)10–20 cm long, glabrous or glabrescent, sometimes with a long-pedicelled flower co-axillary, or male inflorescence existing of one solitary flower at the node only; peduncle 3–7 cm long, 1–1.5 mm thick; rachis with 4–24 flowers; bracts sessile or 1(–2) mm stiped, persistent, suborbicular or (narrowly) elliptic, 7–16(–20) by 2–12 mm, at base usually narrow, without or with several glands, margin entire or sharply 3–5-toothed or shallowly lobed. Male flowers (mature buds) minutely hairy; pedicel 2–6 mm long; receptacle-tube ca 8 mm long, at apex ca 4 mm wide; sepals linear, reflexed, ca 5 mm long, less than 1 mm wide, margin entire; synandrium not seen (see note), filaments glabrous. Female flowers (not known from Thailand): pedicel 30–40 mm long; ovary ellipsoid, ca 20 by 8 mm, brown-hairy; sepals slightly shorter than in male; petals like in male. Fruits (China) orange, ellipsoid (or oblong), 12–18 by 5–10 cm, glabrous; fruiting pedicel (1?–)4–5 cm long. Seeds (pale) brown, oblong obovate, 18–30 by 12–20 by 4–6 mm, apex subrounded, base obtuse to oblique, sometimes slightly emarginate, margin present, edge entire.</br>Field-notes.— Calyx tube pale light yellow-greenish, lobes green, corolla lobes whitish with light green veins; anthers cream.

description: Climber 8–25 m long; brown or grey-white villose, hairs ca 1 mm long, to 3 mm long in sterile running shoots; plant green, petals white; cystoliths not obvious; stem 3–4 mm diam. Probract absent. Tendrils 4–7(–9)-branched, portion below point of branching (1–)2–4 cm long, late glabrescent. Leaves: blade unlobed or shallowly 3–5-lobed or angular, broadly ovate or suborbicular in outline, (8–)10–18 by (4.5–)6–14 cm, villose with whitish hairs above and below, glands few to many, scattered, ca 0.5 mm diam.; base cordate; margin entire; apex acute acuminate, to 12 mm long mucronate; petiole 5–9 cm long. Male inflorescences 10–20(–30) cm long, hairy; peduncle 5–13 cm long, 2–3 mm thick; rachis with 10–20 flowers; most bracts inserted on the pedicel below the middle, subpersistent, ± obovate, 20–40(–60) by 20–30(–40) mm, mostly with small glands, margin subentire or shallowly lobed-dentate. Male flowers shaggy hairy; pedicel ca 30 mm long; receptacle-tube 25–30 mm long, at throat 8–12 mm diam., base ± swollen, forming a ‘pseudo-ovary’; sepals linear or narrowly triangular, 13–20 mm long, 1–2 mm wide at base, margin entire; petals finely hairy, wedge-shaped, 15–20 mm long, threads ca 10 mm long; synandrium 10–12 mm long, filaments 2–3 mm long, glabrous, inserted about halfway along the tube. Female flowers (not seen from Thailand): pedicel 30(–50) mm long; ovary ellipsoid, ca 10 mm long, hairy; otherwise like in male. Fruits green, longitudinally whitish banded, broadly ellipsoid, ca 14 by 11.5 cm, glabrous (glabrescent); pericarp hard fleshy, ca 15 mm thick; exocarp thin, woody-leathery, not wrinkled on drying; pulp white, finely fibrous; fruiting pedicel ca 5 by 0.6 cm. Seeds bright brown, compressed, ovate-oblong, (23–)25–27 by 11–12 by 5–6 mm, base narrowly rounded, apex truncate, notched, and laterally ± bulging, margin 2–3 mm broad, edge rounded, entire.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climber, 3–8 m long; glabrous or partly short-hairy; plant green, petals white; cystoliths obvious or not; stem ca 2 mm thick. Probract obovate ca 4 by 2 mm, with glands (always?). Tendrils 2-branched. Leaves: blade 3-foliolate (in juvenile plants partly simple), lobed or unlobed, suborbicular in outline, middle leaflet obovate-lanceolate, 4.5–9 by 2–4 cm, ± glabrous, glands absent to several, scattered, ca 0.5 mm diam., base long-cuneate, margin entire or minutely sparsely dentate, apex acute-acuminate; lateral leaflets unequal-sided (sometimes deeply 2 lobed), ovate-oblong, of about the same size as the middle one; petiole 2–3.5(–5) cm long, petiolules ca 0.5 cm long. Male inflorescences 9–20 cm long, thinly hairy; peduncle 2–6 cm long, 2(–3) mm thick; rachis with 10(–20) flowers; bracts (sub)persistent, obovate or oblong, 7–13 by 2–7 mm, with glands, margin (entire or) shallowly or deeply dentate-laciniate. Male flowers: pedicel ca 3 mm long; receptacle-tube 20(–40) mm long, narrow in lower half, at apex (3–)5 mm wide; sepals narrowly triangular, 5–7 mm long, ca 2 mm wide at base, entire; expanded petals not seen; synandrium ca 11 mm long, filaments ca 1 mm long, glabrous. Female flowers (not seen in Thai material): pedicel 5–15 mm long; ovary ovoid, ca 10 by 5 mm, glabrous; perianth as in male. Fruits (orange-)red, longitudinally with yellowish streaks, ovoid, ca 7 by 5 cm; pericarp ca 5 mm thick when dry, mature exocarp leathery; pulp greenish-blackish; fruiting pedicel 0.5–2 by ca 0.3 cm. Seeds dark brown, compressed, ovate or elliptic(-oblong), 15–17 by 10–11 by 2 mm, base subtruncate, apex obtuse or subacute, margin broad but obscure, edge entire.

description: Climber 4–15 m long; stem 3–5 mm diam., glabrous or hairy, often with lenticels, older twigs with raised leaf-scars. Tendrils 5–15 cm long, in juvenile plants at apices with irregularly shaped adhesive pads to ca 5 mm diam. Leaves: blade (broadly) ovate-elliptic, 8–15 by 5–10 cm, membranous or subcoriaceous, both surfaces glabrous or hairy; base broadly rounded or cordate or sometimes somewhat hastate; apex (sub)obtuse, minutely mucronate; 2–5-pinnately veined and one pair of basal veins, reticulation distinct on lower surface; petiole 1.5–3 cm long. Male inflorescences glabrous or hairy, (10–)15–60 cm long, little or much branched (sometimes also branched from the base), lateral branches to 15 cm long, flowers often in bundles of up to 5, the bundles ± spaced, the larger inflorescences often from the older wood. Female inflorescences 5–40 cm long, raceme-like or branched panicles, few-or many-flowered, flowers solitary (or 2). Male flowers: pedicels rather thick, 1–3(–5) mm long, articulate at ± halfway; buds 2 mm diam.; sepals membranous, almost free, subtriangular, ca 2 mm long; petals ovate narrowly elliptic, 2.5–3.5 mm long, apex narrowed, subacute, adaxially papillose; stamens inserted on a fleshy disc, leaving the centre free; filaments 0.5–1 mm long, fleshy; anthers transversely ellipsoid, (0.5–)1 mm long. Female flowers: sepals triangular, 2–4 mm long; petals ovate-narrowly elliptic, 3–8 mm long, subacute, finely papillose-hairy; ovary subcylindrical-obconical, 5–12 by 2–3 mm, glabrous or hairy; styles very short; stigmas with 2 incurved horizontal horns, papillose. Fruits pendulous, few to many per infructescence, very variable in size, (4–)5–10 by 1.5–4.5(–5) cm, glabrous, glabrescent or hairy. Seeds pale, elliptic, flat, not ornamented, 15(–20) by 8(–10) mm, winged all around, the wing leathery, much elongated and rounded at both ends; seed with wing 40–60(–80) by 13–15(–20) mm.

description: Subherbaceous 2–6 m long climber; monoecious; plant subglabrous, generally drying (dark) brownish. Leaves: blade ovate-triangular, 4–12 by 3–10 cm, rarely shallowly lobed, base subtruncate or broadly shallowly cordate, margin denticulate, apex acute-acuminate; petiole 2–5 cm long. Inflorescences: in male a peduncled 3–10-flowered short or sometimes ± spike like proliferous raceme, peduncle 1–5 cm long, usually co-axillary with a previously developed single female flower; female flowers solitary or rarely few, sub-umbellate, peduncled. Male flowers: pedicel 1–4 mm long; receptacle-tube ca 3 by 2 mm, inside with long hairs, especially at the throat; sepals 0.5 mm long; petals ovate, ca 2 mm long, subacute, inner surface and apex hairy; stamens inserted halfway along receptacle-tube or rather lower (but not at the base of tube); filaments 1–2 mm long, subglabrous or long-haired about middle; anthers circular in outline, 1 mm diam., thecae curved, the two nearly forming a ring, connective ± hairy, not produced, disc depressed globose, 1 mm diam. Female flowers: pedicel slender, 2–5 mm long; ovary ovoid-globose, ca 3 by 2.5 mm, glabrous (except minute raised gland-dots), neck 1 mm long; perianth as in male flower but petals 2.5–3 mm long; style ca 3 mm long, glabrous, stigma 3-lobed, 1.5–2 mm diam., papillose; disc 0.5 mm high; staminodes slender, ca 2 mm long, the basal portion adnate with the receptacle-tube. Fruit solitary (rarely 2 or 3), globose, 0.8–1.2 mm diam., glabrous, green, at last red, finely netted or pitted when dry; fruiting pedicel 0.3–1 cm long. Seeds rather many, (narrowly) elliptic, ca 5 by 3–3.5 mm, narrowly margined, smooth, pale brownish when dry.

description: Annual delicate climber 50–100 cm long; monoecious; subglabrous; green on drying. Leaves: blade subovate in outline, 3–9 by 2.5–8 cm, (3–)5-angular or shallowly lobed, scabrid with minute cystoliths above, base shallowly or deeply cordate, margin sparsely shallowly dentate, apex acute or (long-)acuminate; petiole 1.5–3.5 cm long. Male inflorescence a solitary slender peduncled spike-like raceme; peduncle 1.5–4 cm long, flower-bearing portion 2–4.5 cm long, with 5–15 patently short-pedicelled, spaced flowers, the basal ones usually paired. Male flowers: pedicel 2.5–4 mm long, glabrous; perianth 2.5–3 mm diam.; receptacle tube (broad) cup-shaped, 1.5–2 by 2–3 mm, glabrous except few slender hairs inside; sepals 0.2 mm long; petals ovate-elliptic, 0.8–1 by 0.8–1 mm, subobtuse, minutely papillose towards apex; stamens inserted near the base of the receptacle-tube; filaments 1.5–1.8 mm long, glabrous; anthers 0.3 mm diam., thecae vertical, somewhat curved, 0.2–0.3 mm long, connective slightly swollen, with few stiff hairs; disc depressed globose, 0.5 by 1 mm. Female flowers solitary on the node or co-axillary with male raceme; pedicel filiform, 12–15 mm long; ovary fusiform-ellipsoid, ca 1.5 by 1.2 mm, glabrous, neck nearly 1 mm long; perianth as in male flower; style 1–1.2 mm long, stigma 0.7 mm diam., consisting of 3 sessile subglobose papillose free lobes; staminodes not seen; disc conspicuous, a ± 3-lobed ring, 0.5 mm high, at base partly connate with receptacle. Fruit globose, ca 0.6 cm diam., few-seeded; pericarp thin, leaving the seeds shining through; fruiting pedicel 1.5–2.5 cm long. Seeds flat, pyriform in outline, ca 5 by 3 mm, narrowly margined, smooth, pale.
